summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property, capture/clear logic in update, advance, reset and Task._reset, and the new TimeElapsedColumn class); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with local imports and a TYPE_CHECKING table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entries); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns, expected output edited by hand from a clock-read trace); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). Nothing was run, so all tests are unverified. Please run pytest on tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_palette.py. The test_columns expected string was derived by hand. The finished-frame bar shrinks by 7 cells, not 8, because task 2's speed now truncates to '1 byte/s' and narrows the speed column. The palette table headers are Index, RGB and Color, which the spec did not name. Nothing was committed.
